<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916877_theRebbe_274" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916877_theRebbe_274__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the power for each Jew to have the Shechinah dwell within them comes from Moshe's initial drawing down of the Shechinah, just as the revelation at Sinai empowered future divine drawing down, and the Mishkan's construction made the physical a vessel for revelation, enabling this in the Temple and the spiritual sanctuary of each Jew.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And to add,</t>
    <t s="1">that this that the interpretation of "and I will dwell in their midst"</t>
    <t s="2">(in the plural)</t>
    <t s="3">is that He dwells within each and every one of Israel,</t>
    <t s="4">(in the maamar)</t>
    <t s="5">following upon this that the descent and drawing down of the Shechinah below was through Moshe,</t>
    <t s="6">it is,</t>
    <t s="7">because the power in each Jew to draw down so that the essential Shechinah dwells in him is through the drawing down of the essential Shechinah below that was through Moshe.</t>
    <t s="8">For just as the descent and drawing down below that was at the Giving of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="9">"and God descended upon Mount Sinai"14,</t>
    <t s="10">was in a manner that through this the power was given that also after the Giving of the Torah they could draw down a revelation of G-dliness below</t>
    <t s="11">[for this is what our sages said15,</t>
    <t s="12">that at the Giving of the Torah the decree that the upper ones shall not descend below was nullified,</t>
    <t s="13">the meaning of the nullification of the decree is that from now on there can be a descent of the upper ones below],</t>
    <t s="14">similarly it is regarding the descent and drawing down below that was through the Mishkan that Moshe made</t>
    <t s="15">[for among the advantages of the drawing down that was in the Mishkan relative to the drawing down that was at the Giving of the Torah is16,</t>
    <t s="16">that the drawing down below that was at the Giving of the Torah was from the aspect of Above</t>
    <t s="17">(and therefore the revelation was only temporary),</t>
    <t s="18">and the drawing down in the Mishkan was in a manner that the lower</t>
    <t s="19">(the physical things from which the Mishkan was made)</t>
    <t s="20">became a vessel for the revelation],</t>
    <t s="21">that through Moshe bringing down and drawing the Shechinah into the Mishkan in a manner that the lower became a vessel for the revelation,</t>
    <t s="22">through this the power was given to draw down G-dliness in this manner in the Holy Temple,</t>
    <t s="23">and also in the spiritual sanctuary within each and every Jew.</t>
    <t s="24">And through the fact that the drawing down in the Mishkan was in a manner that through it a revelation of G-dliness was drawn also into the entirety of the world,</t>
    <t s="25">it became similarly also in the spiritual sanctuary within each Jew,</t>
    <t s="26">that the indwelling of the Shechinah in the person</t>
    <t s="27">("and I will dwell in their midst")</t>
    <t s="28">will be in a manner that through it a revelation of G-dliness will be drawn also into the world</t>
    <t s="29">("and they shall dwell forever upon it").</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the reason the essential Shechinah was in the lower worlds is because G-d's ultimate desire is for a dwelling place in the lower realms, achieved through the service of subjugation and transformation (itkafya and it'hapcha), which draws down a light transcending connection to worlds.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And the maamar continues,</t>
    <t s="2">that the reason for this that the essential Shechinah was in the lower worlds,</t>
    <t s="3">it is,</t>
    <t s="4">because the ultimate purpose in the creation and coming into being of the worlds is that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have for Himself a dwelling place in the lower worlds17.</t>
    <t s="5">And it explains,</t>
    <t s="6">that this that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have for Himself a dwelling place in the lower worlds is that there should be a revelation of G-dliness below through the service of man,</t>
    <t s="7">through itkafya and it'hapcha.</t>
    <t s="8">[And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="9">that what is said in the maamar that the revelation of G-dliness below is through the service of itkafya and it'hapcha, this refers</t>
    <t s="10">(also)</t>
    <t s="11">to "He desired... a dwelling place in the lower worlds."</t>
    <t s="12">That is,</t>
    <t s="13">that in this that He desired that there be a dwelling place in the lower worlds,</t>
    <t s="14">there are several matters.</t>
    <t s="15">That there be a revelation of G-dliness below – in the lower worlds,</t>
    <t s="16">and that the revelation of G-dliness below be not through a drawing down from above but through the service of man – the service of the lower ones,</t>
    <t s="17">and that the service through which the revelation is drawn below be the service of itkafya and it'hapcha – service that is from the aspect of the lower worlds].</t>
    <t s="18">And the maamar continues,</t>
    <t s="19">that the revelation that is drawn below through the service of itkafya and it'hapcha is a revelation that is above relation to worlds.</t>
    <t s="20">[And this is that through "and they shall make for Me a Sanctuary" there was the drawing down of the essential Shechinah below,</t>
    <t s="21">for the essential Shechinah is the light that is above relation to worlds18,</t>
    <t s="22">because the service of making the Mishkan is the service of itkafya and it'hapcha,</t>
    <t s="23">and through this service is the drawing down of the light that is above worlds,</t>
    <t s="24">the essential Shechinah].</t>
    <t s="25">And as the statement19</t>
    <t s="26">"When the sitra achra is subdued, the glory of the Holy One, blessed be He, is elevated in all worlds,"</t>
    <t s="27">for the interpretation of "in all worlds" is a light that is in all worlds equally,</t>
    <t s="28">and it is the light that is above relation to worlds,</t>
    <t s="29">and through the service of itkafya and it'hapcha is drawn20</t>
    <t s="30">this light.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the service in the Mishkan and Temple, particularly the sacrificial service, is the service of itkafya leading to it'hapcha, and this is the primary means of drawing down the essential Shechinah, both through the construction and the ongoing service within it.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And the maamar continues in the second chapter</t>
    <t s="2">(the chapter pertaining to this year21),</t>
    <t s="3">that the service that was in the Mishkan and Temple is the service of itkafya that brings to it'hapcha.</t>
    <t s="4">And therefore one of the services22</t>
    <t s="5">that were in the Temple is the service of the offerings,</t>
    <t s="6">because the matter of the service of the offerings is itkafya and it'hapcha</t>
    <t s="7">(as will be explained below).</t>
    <t s="8">And behold, the connection of this matter</t>
    <t s="9">[that the service that was in the Mishkan and Temple is the service of itkafya and it'hapcha]</t>
    <t s="10">with what is explained at the beginning of the discourse</t>
    <t s="11">(simply)</t>
    <t s="12">is,</t>
    <t s="13">that since the drawing down of the essential Shechinah in the lower worlds was primarily in the Mishkan and Temple,</t>
    <t s="14">and the drawing down of the essential Shechinah below is through the service of itkafya and it'hapcha,</t>
    <t s="15">therefore,</t>
    <t s="16">the primary service that was in the Mishkan and Temple is the service of itkafya and it'hapcha.</t>
    <t s="17">However,</t>
    <t s="18">that at the beginning of the maamar it speaks about the matter of drawing down the essential Shechinah below</t>
    <t s="19">("and I will dwell in their midst")</t>
    <t s="20">through the making of the Mishkan</t>
    <t s="21">("and they shall make for Me a Sanctuary"),</t>
    <t s="22">and in this chapter it adds,</t>
    <t s="23">that also the drawing down in the Mishkan and Temple</t>
    <t s="24">[after its making,</t>
    <t s="25">for this drawing down is more elevated than the drawing down that was through the making of the Mishkan]</t>
    <t s="26">is through the service of itkafya and it'hapcha.</t>
    <t s="27">And therefore,</t>
    <t s="28">the primary service that was in the Mishkan and Temple is the service of the offerings,</t>
    <t s="29">itkafya and it'hapcha.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
